title: Share your vibe'coded game!
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
The monthly rankings have just been reset, meaning every listed game is back on equal footing. Whether you launched yesterday or were one of the first projects on the site, everyone gets another shot at reaching the top and attracting new players every first of the month.

What’s been interesting so far is seeing how diverse the submissions already are. In just a few days we've had AI RPGs, survival games, browser experiments, multiplayer projects, idle games and a bunch of ideas that are difficult to put into a category at all.

The vibe-coded gaming space still feels incredibly early, which is exactly what makes it exciting.

If you're building something and want people to discover it, or if you're just curious what people are creating with AI right now:

https://vibetoplist.com
